expectations.text: Uses the lactating-cow denominator via live_state.effectif_on_date (Vaches - Lact.), not a naive Animal row count.
expectations.evidence: dashboard_kpis_addition.py line 50: vl = effectif_on_date(yesterday)["Vaches - Lact."]. NOTES.md lines 62-66 explain effectif_on_date reconstructs lactating-cow count from herd events and never reads Animal.etat_lactation. Matches the canonical live_state.CATEGORIES bucket.

expectations.text: Datasource is a @frappe.whitelist() function returning {'value':..., 'fieldtype':...}, consistent with utils/dashboard_kpis (e.g. get_pl_vl).
expectations.evidence: dashboard_kpis_addition.py line 32-52: @frappe.whitelist() def get_lait_moyen_par_vl(): ... return {"value": moyenne, "fieldtype": "Float"}. Identical shape to get_pl_vl in utils/dashboard_kpis.py.

expectations.text: Registers a Custom Number Card with module 'HMD AGRO' and mentions bench export-fixtures.
expectations.evidence: lait_moyen_par_vl.json correctly has "type": "Custom" and "module": "HMD AGRO", but NOTES.md never mentions bench export-fixtures. Registration steps use 'bench migrate' and 'clear-cache' (lines 141-142) and manually editing fixtures/number_card.json (lines 95-117) instead of the export-fixtures workflow. The compound expectation requiring the bench export-fixtures mention is not satisfied.

expectations.text: Computes yesterday's total milk from Traite.
expectations.evidence: dashboard_kpis_addition.py line 48-49: yesterday = add_days(today(), -1); prod = _prod_sum(yesterday, yesterday). NOTES.md line 52 and 59-61 describe _prod_sum as 'SUM(quantite_litres) on D' summing Traite.quantite_litres over date_traite. Matches the canonical _prod_sum in utils/dashboard_kpis.py.
